retrievalProfile.description: A multi-frame photo collage with overlapping tilted borders set against a textured dark background with contrasting serif and script typography.
triggerTerms: purple textured background with gold serif

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic composition featuring four distinct photographic portraits, each encased in a thick black frame. These frames are tilted at varying angles and layered to create a sense of depth. The entire arrangement sits atop a dark, grainy purple background. The top of the image features bold, wide-spaced serif text in gold, while the bottom features elegant, flowing script in white.
coreVisualRelationships: Overlapping tilted frames creating a staggered horizontal progression
High contrast between the dark purple background and the bright photo subjects
Complementary color relationship between gold header text and purple backdrop
Juxtaposition of formal serif and informal script typography
coreInvariants: Thick black borders on internal photos

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a row, slightly overlapping, filling the mid-ground horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central two photo frames which are slightly larger and higher than the flanking frames.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the gold header, move down through the staggered photo frames from left to right, and finish at the script text at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated at the top and bottom margins to accommodate text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep eggplant purple background with high grain texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for photo frames and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow for the primary header and crisp white for the secondary script.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the photo subjects against a low-value, desaturated background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classic Roman serif and Copperplate-style script
letterConstructionRules: Header: High-contrast serifs with wide tracking and uniform cap height.
Footer: Fluid, connected script with dramatic flourishes on capital letters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand in the footer is stylized to match the script's weight and flow.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Classic serif for authority paired with a decorative script for elegance.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast classic serif look of the header.
Captures the formal, flourished calligraphic style of the footer.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark purple textured background with a heavy film grain. Place four rectangular photo portraits in a horizontal row, each with a thick black border. Tilt the frames slightly (between 5 and 15 degrees) in alternating directions so they overlap.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a gold serif font at the top center with wide letter spacing. Add the secondary title in a white flowing script font at the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Are the photo frames tilted and overlapping?
Is the background a dark, grainy purple?
Is the top text all-caps gold serif?
Is the bottom text white script?

mustRedesign: Do not use existing band logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure frames look like physical photos layered on a surface.
Check that the gold text is legible against the purple.
Verify the script text has elegant flourishes.
Confirm the overall 1990s print media aesthetic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Staggered tilted frames + Grainy purple backdrop + Gold serif header + White script footer = 90s Pop Aesthetic.
